title: ThinkFlow: pick up your thinking right where you left off
description: End each session with one unfinished line, and it’s waiting at the top next time. Every feature is free, and your notes stay on your device.

hero.headline:
Yesterday’s half-finished thought,
picked up right where it stopped
hero.lead: When you stop thinking, leave one line to continue from. Next time you open the app, that line is waiting at the top.
hero.cta: Get it free on the App Store
hero.note: Every feature is free. No account, everything stays on your device.

demo.title: Try leaving a bridge
demo.lead: Add a thought, then leave the line you’ll pick up next time. It works in the same order as the app.
demo.lock: Leave a bridge sentence before closing
demo.bridgeTitle: Stop while you’re on a roll
demo.bridge: So if I design some ‘deliberate boredom’, will deep thinking come back?
demo.coreText: The gap in reward delay is what gets in the way of deep thinking
demo.last: When I go for a walk without my phone, my thoughts just keep going. Maybe boredom is what invites thinking.
demo.ex1: What if I stop avoiding boredom and put it in my calendar? Twenty minutes a day of doing nothing.
demo.ex2: If I keep a boring 20 minutes at the same time every day, what thoughts will show up?
demo.later: This is what greets you next time: the line you just left is right at the top.

problem.title: Wait, where was I going with this?
problem.text: You reopen a note from last week and find a couple of conclusions, but not the question you were about to chase. So you start over from scratch. ThinkFlow has you leave that next question when you stop, so you start from it the moment you come back.

features.title: Your bridge is waiting at the top
features.text:
End a session with one line: the question to pick up next. When you return, that line, your key points so far and your latest thought sit on one card, so there’s nothing to reconstruct.
Your bridge shows on a Home Screen widget too, and while you think, the time runs on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

features.title: From rough note to key point
features.text:
Move each thought up through four levels: note, refined, key point and summary. You can see at a glance how far a thought has matured.
What you looked up or asked about goes in as a reference, kept apart from your own thinking.

features.title: Empty your head first
features.text:
Write down everything on your mind, one line each, then pick the one to work on now. It becomes a thread; the rest waits on the home screen until you tap it.
Thoughts you haven’t touched in over three days are gathered under Thoughts to revive.

items.title: Dump your thoughts
items.text: One line each, then pick the one worth growing.

items.title: Keep thinking
items.text: Add each new idea as its own note so it’s easy to refine later.

items.title: Leave a bridge and close
items.text: Next time, you start from that line.

reference.title: Refinement level
reference.note: Tap the level badge next to a thought to change it. Key points and summaries come first on the card when you return.

faq.title: Your bridge is waiting at the top

items.q: Do I have to write a bridge?
items.a: If you added anything, yes: the Continue Thinking screen only closes once you leave the next line. If you didn’t write anything, just close it. The trick is to stop while you still have something to say, not when you’re stuck.
Threads you haven’t opened in over three days are collected in their own section on the home screen, so a forgotten idea can pick up again from its bridge.

items.q: How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?
items.a: Use Send Feedback in the app’s settings, write to the address below, or open an issue at github.com/M1zz/ThinkFlow/issues. Anything is welcome.
Yes. Every feature is free, with no ads and no account. Support the Developer in Settings is entirely optional and doesn’t unlock anything.
